items.title: John Altman interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, September 14, 2023
items.q: Paul Desmond was the master of that.

ctx.x: But it’s an interesting process because you have to realize how do I fit this particular tune into this particular key? Right? It’s a mental gymnastics sort of thing.

Yeah, well the great one is — oh no, it’s one of the Christmas numbers that Chet Baker plays “June in January” in. I’m trying to remember which one. But it’s quite startling you know. Paul Desmond was the master of that.
Oh yes. Your career has gone from splicing tape and using a pencil and pad to today where things seem to change almost every year. Are there positives and negatives for you?
